messages:
tara: FYI us-east-1 prefill smoke flapping after rolling rec-embedger 4.0.2 to canary. p95 spikes and intermittent 504s from the smoke harness. @liam @devops pls triage.

liam: which canary/tag? i'll grab the synthetic traces.

tara: canary-tag=rec-embedger-4.0.2-canary-20260324 region=us-east-1. quick repro: ```curl -sS -X POST https://use1.embed.redwood/smoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{\"q\":\"hello\"}' -w "\\nHTTP:%{http_code}\\n"``` -> HTTP:504, body {\"error\":\"upstream_timeout\"}.

deploy-bot: rollout started: rec-embedger-4.0.2 -> us-east-1 (canary=7%) at 2925007700. initial probes reported green.

liam: tracing shows LB drain events overlapping with new worker warmstarts. prefill logs contain repeated lines: \"prefill: jittered start; waiting for kvcache warmup\" followed by connection resets and 502/504s. suspect LB drain timeout too aggressive for new warmstart behavior.

tara: can't let this ripple. propose pausing canary growth and pin us-east-1 back to rec-embedger-3.9.8 while we debug. pin preferred to full rollback for speed.

devops: +1 from infra. plan: stop further canary increments, apply route pin to 3.9.8 for use1, and temporarily increase LB drain timeout to reduce false positives during warmstart repro.

ops-bot: incident INC-8123 created: \"rec-embedger prefill jitter us-east-1\" assigned to liam, devops.

liam: applying route pin now. routing rec-embedger -> 3.9.8 for us-east-1. ETA ~90s.

tara: lowering smoke timeout threshold to catch tail behaviour while we investigate. adding release note: \"us-east-1 canary paused for rec-embedger-4.0.2 due to prefill/LB-drain jitter; investigating warmstart+drain interaction.\"

devops: pin complete, traffic back on 3.9.8. smoke probes returned to green.

liam: i'll run a controlled repro with staggered warmstarts and an increased LB drain to capture trace timelines and post kernel/prefill logs here. if repro shows warmstart latency > drain timeout, mitigation options: stagger warmstart, bump drain, or make warmstart non-blocking for liveness.

tara: hold on full rollback for now. keep region pinned until repro + mitigation validated. update the deploy ticket with the pin and next steps. please post a short postmortem blurb here once root cause and mitigation are confirmed. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder: follow the release pin checklist in the runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/release-pins

devops: will post repro logs in ~30m and schedule a quick infra sync if needed. leaving thread open for handoff.

tara: thanks team, cc'ing product for visibility.
